text:
emily: quick sync — final guardrail matrix for last-mile GA. need owners for: SLA numbers, docs scope, support oncall rota, monitoring alerts, pricing tiers. who can take what?

jordan: i can own SLA targets + SLO docs. proposed: 99.9% for paid, 99.5% for free tier. keep error budget per-customer.

sasha: i'll take monitoring — can we standardize alert thresholds? p50/p95 latency alerts + token error rate > 0.5% triggers. also want log sampling guidance.

miguel: support rota — need clarity on escalation for Dedicated vs Hosted. propose: Dedicated -> priority on-call, Hosted -> tiered support w/ ops fallback. will draft runbook.

cleo: docs scope — i'll trim the GA docs to include quickstart, troubleshooting, SLA table, rollback steps, and a one-pager for sales. ETA EOD Thu.

emily: thanks. jordan, can you paste SLO definitions in-line? need exact math for the SLA page.

jordan: sure — SLA calc: "availability = 1 - (minutes_unavailable / total_minutes_in_period)". availability window = 30d rolling. error budget = (1 - SLA)*total_minutes. will add examples.

sasha: monitoring snippet i'll add:

```
alert: high_latency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.5
for: 5m
```

also alert for "token_generation_errors_total / tokens_emitted_total > 0.005".

miguel: oncall handoff: we need playbook lines for failover to fallback model and for quota throttling. I'll include escalation matrix (SRE -> Eng runtime -> Product).

oncall-bot: scheduled canary rollout at 2024-06-10T22:00Z for model v1.1 (notifying impacted routing).

emily: pricing readiness — who owns pricing doc alignment? we need clear per-token rates, burst pricing, and reserved capacity discounts.

cleo: sales one-pager will have ranges. finance needs final numbers but i can draft language.

jordan: action items:
- jordan: publish SLA+SLO section (owner)
- sasha: add alerts + dashboards
- miguel: draft support runbook + escalation
- cleo: GA docs + sales one-pager
- emily: coordinate final signoff with finance and legal

emily: target checklist for GA signoff: SLA doc, runbook, monitoring dashboards, docs published, pricing ranges agreed, oncall staffing confirmed. want a greenlight by Mon.

sasha: sounds good — i'll upload dashboard links when ready.

miguel: will schedule a 30m sync Fri to review runbook.

emily: thanks all. if anyone needs to move deadlines ping me directly. :thumbsup:
